content.value: The base item decides its native damage or defence, requirement profile, compatible affix pool, and best random rune tier. Runes and quality build on top of that base.

[[item/minecraft:leather|Leather]]: 60 total evasion and 15% total movement speed across a full set; [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]]-aligned.
Gold: 55 total armour, 35 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]], and 7% rarity of items found; [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]]/Intelligence hybrid.
Chainmail: 60 total armour, 35 evasion, and +0.30 attack speed across the set; [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]]/Dexterity hybrid.
Iron: 120 total armour and 20% knockback resistance; [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]]-aligned.
[[item/minecraft:diamond|Diamond]]: 300 total armour, +10 maximum health, and 0.75 health regeneration per second; [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]]-aligned.
Netherite: 500 total armour from its base scaling plus knockback resistance and 25% [[stat/cranks-dungeons:fire_resistance|fire resistance]] across the set; [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]]-aligned.
[[item/minecraft:turtle_helmet|Turtle Helmet]]: a fixed Unique base with 45 armour.
[[item/minecraft:elytra|Elytra]]: a fixed Unique base with 90 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]].

Swords, spears, bows, crossbows, and shields can use the ordinary rune system. Spears, bows, and crossbows count as two-handed. The vanilla mace and trident are Unique items and therefore do not use ordinary rune pools.

Axes, pickaxes, shovels, and hoes cannot receive rune affixes and cannot be improved with quality materials. They can receive [[item/cranks-dungeons:deepslate_sigil|Deepslate Sigil]] enchantment slots up to their normal cap and can use compatible enchantments.

An armour base is classified by whether it naturally has armour, evasion, [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]], or a hybrid. A random affix whose affinity requires a defence the item does not have is excluded. For example, a pure [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]]/evasion base cannot roll a [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]]-only armour family.
Local percentages become more valuable as the underlying base improves. Compare the finished item total, not only the rune text.
